acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Doppelgangers family through its blank faceplate and single flawed reach while remaining an obviously artificial fully covered construct.
Reads specifically as Blank, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Featureless-Reach Initiate archetype and its probing battlefield duty.
Shows exactly one fully covered magical training automaton with complete limbs, prop-like joints, and believable ground contact.
Builds Water as a sealed external glass pressure loop around the wrist and arm; the opaque body shell never becomes liquid, wet, transparent, or revealing.
Keeps the wrist-seam telegraph and drained pressure-loop counterplay visible at gameplay scale.

anatomyInvariants: A single stylized magical training automaton with a seamless featureless porcelain faceplate and an integral opaque high-collared, long-sleeved, booted matte-grey armor shell; every surface is fully covered hard-shell costume material and no organic anatomy is visible.
Signature mechanic: Unpainted Reach: one telescoping suit-covered arm extends from a fixed shoulder, then retracts through a visible mechanical wrist seam in the integral shell.
battlefieldDuty: Probe close timing with one smooth unfinished reach from a deliberately generic stance.
constructionDimensions: Material/structure branches: T1 blank smooth flesh and one featureless limb gain an external pressure loop without marking the body; T2 the partial copy and unfinished arm gain a reflective copied-surface fill; T3 the jaw seam and wrong hand gain coherent conduits; T4 layered faces and mask edges gain mist valves; T5 body-wide faces and mask crown gain bounded cistern latches.

Motion/process branches: T1 the blank featureless limb fills and drains one external silhouette loop; T2 the partial copy drains color toward the unfinished arm; T3 the wrong hand reverses jaw-seam conduit flow; T4 layered faces rotate fluid through one mask valve; T5 body-wide faces pressurize and empty one mask-crown latch.
counterplay: Step across the extending arm and strike the temporary wrist crease before it smooths. Affinity signal: Affinity counterplay branches: T1 pressure loss opens the blank smooth-flesh featureless-limb loop; T2 the partial copy exposes a drained fill at the unfinished arm; T3 the jaw seam and wrong hand expose the empty conduit after reversal; T4 layered faces expose the mask valve after drainage; T5 body-wide faces expose the mask-crown cistern latch after pressure loss, preserving copy readability.

identityInvariants: A generic humanoid copy silhouette retains one deliberate flaw until layered face and mask motifs appear at explicit upper tiers.

telegraph: The opaque shell's mechanical wrist seam compresses while the blank porcelain faceplate and fully covered training automaton remain perfectly still.
